title: Processes: Weather and bioclimate
intro: Daisy reads daily or hourly weather (air temperature, global radiation, precipitation, reference evapotranspiration and, if available, wind and vapour pressure) and the Bioclimate module splits the energy and water between canopy, litter, snow, pond and soil. The potential evapotranspiration is shared out by the cover of each layer.
